text_block_list.text:
Huh? I could've sworn someone was
callin' for
me...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Maybe I was just imagining things...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, the Three Goddesses statue. Might
as well
offer a prayer for the road.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Please keep everyone safe so they can
keep
doing their best!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
